target: LOI (%) of flame-retarded rigid PU foams, independently compiled from the literature (reconstruction of the Sun/Fu 2026 population, not their 435 rows)
declared: 2026-10-01 21:56 PDT by Opus 5.5, before any model is fit on these rows
dataset: data/v2/loi_rpuf_literature.csv built by data/v2/build_loi_rpuf.py from rows_w1..w5 (QA: 1 true error in 52 rows, no corrections needed for rows with LOI). Benchmark of record EXCLUDES extraction == figure rows and rows with blank loi_pct: 333 rows / 56 papers. Neat-foam controls kept. Amended before any fit (was w1..w3).

features.F1_loading: total_fr_wtpct and per-class wt% of foam (cls_*), converted by build_loi_rpuf.py (polyol-basis loadings use the paper's isocyanate parts, else 130 parts, flagged)
features.F2_class: covered by cls_* columns (wt% of foam per FR class)
features.F3_elements: el_P, el_N, el_Si, el_B, el_halogen, el_metal (wt% of foam); NaN where any FR lacks an element-table entry (29%)

protocols.A: random 80/20 split repeated 50 times (theirs) — R2 mean and 2.5/97.5 percentiles
protocols.B: GroupKFold by source paper, 5 folds x 10 repeats, pooled OOF; source-paper bootstrap 95% CI (PRIMARY for any claim)
protocols.C: GroupKFold by dominant FR class, pooled OOF

candidates.desc: Ridge (standardized, alpha=1.0) on F1+F2+F3(NaN->0 with missing indicators)+F4(median-imputed in-fold)
XGBoost if installed else skip: n_estimators=400, max_depth=4, learning_rate=0.05, subsample=0.8, colsample_bytree=0.8, random_state=0
HistGradientBoosting learning_rate=0.05, max_iter=300, max_leaf_nodes=15, min_samples_leaf=5, random_state=0

selection_rule: Highest protocol-B mean. Protocol A is reported for comparison with Sun/Fu's 0.84 only; it can never be the basis of a claim because random splits leak formulations of the same paper across folds.
exit_triggers: Protocol-B ci_lo > 0.84 -> EXIT condition 5. Protocol-A mean > 0.84 is reported with the population/reconstruction caveat and also raised as EXIT 5 (claim ambiguity) because it is the number people will compare.
claim_wording: 'independently compiled N rows from M papers of the same population (flame-retarded RPUF formulations from the literature)'
